Class SignRequestClaimsSet

java.lang.Object
se.oidc.nimbus.signrequest.SignRequestClaimsSet
public class SignRequestClaimsSet extends Object
The claims of a JWT holding a Signature Request Parameter that is passed as a custom request parameter, see sections 3.1.1.1 and 3.1.2 of Signature Extension for OpenID Connect, version 1.2.

The JWT holds the fields of the SignRequest as top-level claims together with the iss (client ID) and aud claims, and optionally the iat and exp claims.

Note: If the signature request parameter is passed in a Request Object, this class is not used. In that case the Request Object holds the iss, aud, iat and exp claims, and the parameter value is a SignRequest JSON object.

Author:
Martin Lindström

  • Constructor Details

    • SignRequestClaimsSet

      public SignRequestClaimsSet(ClientID clientId, Audience audience, Instant issueTime, Instant expirationTime, SignRequest signRequest)
      Constructor.

      Since JWT times have second precision, the supplied times are truncated to seconds.

      Parameters:
      clientId - the client ID of the Relying Party, used as the iss claim
      audience - the audience, i.e., the Issuer Identifier or Authorization Endpoint URL of the OpenID Provider
      issueTime - the issue time (iat), may be null, but is recommended
      expirationTime - the expiration time (exp), may be null, but is recommended
      signRequest - the sign request

    • SignRequestClaimsSet

      public SignRequestClaimsSet(ClientID clientId, List<Audience> audience, Instant issueTime, Instant expirationTime, SignRequest signRequest)
      Constructor.

      Since JWT times have second precision, the supplied times are truncated to seconds.

      Parameters:
      clientId - the client ID of the Relying Party, used as the iss claim
      audience - the audience values (at least one)
      issueTime - the issue time (iat), may be null, but is recommended
      expirationTime - the expiration time (exp), may be null, but is recommended
      signRequest - the sign request

    • sign

      public SignedJWT sign(JWSSigner signer, JWSHeader header) throws JOSEException
      Creates a signed JWT holding the claims. The result should be serialized and used as the value of the https://id.oidc.se/param/signRequest request parameter.
      Parameters:
      signer - the signer, using the client's registered key
      header - the JWS header
      Returns:
      a signed JWT
      Throws:

    • parse

      public static SignRequestClaimsSet parse(JWTClaimsSet claimsSet) throws ParseException
      Parses the supplied JWTClaimsSet into a SignRequestClaimsSet.

      Note: This method does not check the signature, the audience or the validity time of the JWT. Use SignRequestClaimsVerifier for this.

      Parameters:
      claimsSet - the claims set
      Returns:
      a SignRequestClaimsSet
      Throws:
      ParseException - if required claims are missing, or for invalid sign request contents
